title: Handling of NAS COUNT and NAS sequence number

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter value used in NAS security procedures to ensure freshness and prevent replay attacks.

entities.name: NAS sequence number
entities.description: Sequence number included in NAS messages to maintain order and detect duplication.

entities.name: NAS security procedure
entities.description: Procedure that utilizes NAS COUNT and NAS sequence number for security mechanisms like integrity protection and ciphering.

relations.description: NAS security procedure uses NAS COUNT for protection against replay attacks.
NAS security procedure uses NAS sequence number to ensure message order and integrity.
NAS COUNT may influence the handling or validation of NAS sequence number.
